A '''droid manufacturing company''' had manufactured the [[R1-M8 service droid]] by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].<ref name="Mission" /> By around [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Date">Per the reasoning [[Template:TOR_dates|here]], Act I of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' takes place around [[3643 BBY]]. Since players of ''The Old Republic'' can assign their companions on the mission "Domestic Dysfunction" independently of the main class storyline at any point during the [[Star Wars video games|game]], the mission must take place at some point around 3643 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]].</ref> several R1-M8 [[Droid/Legends|droids]] malfunctioned and attacked their owners. The malfunctions were the result of the actions of a rookie [[Unidentified rookie slicer|slicer]] who sought to sabotage the company.<ref name="Mission" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars: The Old Republic}}
Around that [[Standard year/Legends|year]], an individual associated with one of the two opposing sides of the Cold War sent a companion to learn the cause of the malfunctioning R1-M8 [[Service droid/Legends|service droids]]. The companion traced the malfunction back to the [[Slicer/Legends|slicer]], who was arrested, and the manufacturing company provided a reward for his arrest.<ref name="Mission" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
The droid manufacturer was mentioned in the Crew Skill Mission "Domestic Dysfunction" in the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', released by [[BioWare]]. The information regarding the mission's outcome was later removed from the game.<ref name="Mission" />
